map.由利息所得与适用税率计算代扣税。: Compute withholding tax from interest income and the applicable rate.
map.对利息收入 × 税率计征，算税后利息。: Levy interest income x rate to compute after-tax interest.
map.对比存款、债券利息的含税收益。: Compare tax-inclusive returns on deposits vs bonds.
map.评估免税利息收入（如国债）的差异。: Assess the difference from tax-exempt interest (e.g. government bonds).
map.利息所得税 = 5000 × 0.20 = 1,000 元；税后利息 = 500: Interest income tax = 5000 x 0.20 = 1,000; after-tax interest = 5000 - 1000 = 4,000.
map.若利息来自免税品种（税率 0），则所得税 0、税后利息全额 5000 元。: If interest is from a tax-exempt item (rate 0), tax 0 and after-tax interest is the full 5000.
map.国债、地方债等特定品种利息常免征所得税，具体以现行税法为准。: Interest on treasury and local bonds is often exempt; follow current tax law.
map.税率用小数还是百分数？: Enter rate as decimal or percent?
map.r 输入百分数（如 20 代表 20%），内部按 0.20 计算。: Enter r as a percent (e.g. 20 means 20%); it is treated as 0.20 internally.
map.利息所得税：税额 = 利息 × (税率% ÷ 100)（元，税率按百分数输入、内: Interest income tax: tax = interest × (rate% ÷ 100) (CNY, rate entered as a percentage and converted to a decimal internally); linked values: after-tax interest = interest × (1−rate÷100) (CNY), interest to tax multiple = interest ÷ ((interest×rate÷100)||1) (denominator falls back to 1 when tax is 0). Validation: no strict validation, empty values fall back to 0. Rule: no fixed grading; tax is linearly related to both interest and rate; example interest 5,000 at 20% → tax 1,000 CNY.
